metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them a favor and somehow got 2 clueless kills?! Valorant logic is broken
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my mouse had a personal grudge.
Enemy probably rage-uninstalled mid-round.
Pretending I meant that for a hot 0.11 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a total mystery but kills sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s chaos but the kills keep popping!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
